## Current role

Applied AI Architect & GenAI Systems Lead at Accenture Ireland, Dublin (Aug 2025 – present).
Leading design and delivery of production GenAI systems for regulated enterprise clients.

## What I build

I build production GenAI systems for regulated environments:
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with hybrid vector/keyword/graph stacks
- Agentic workflows with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and audit trails
- LLM evaluation — refusal behavior, groundedness, instruction drift, cost/latency, failure taxonomy
- Observability and LLMOps — Langfuse, MLflow, quality/safety/cost/latency monitoring
- Security controls — prompt injection defense, sandboxed execution, role-based access control
- AI governance — risk classification, auditability, EU AI Act readiness, policy-to-implementation

## Prior experience

National Science Foundation — Lead Data Scientist / AI Oversight (GS-15), reporting directly to NSF's Chief AI Officer, Sep 2024 – Aug 2025.
Built NSF's first vector and graph database capabilities. Created an initial AI deployment playbook. Co-chaired 100+ member AI Community of Practice.
Note: This work occurred during the early build-out of NSF's Chief AI Officer function and before NSF's later public AI Strategy was drafted and published. I did not author the published strategy.

Accenture Federal Services — Machine Learning Engineer Manager, Jun 2021 – Sep 2024.
Shipped State Department GenAI, Army secured automation, IARPA global geospatial CV. Personally achieved 99% ML infrastructure cost reduction on global geospatial platform.

Booz Allen Hamilton — Lead Scientist, DARPA program management. $30M+ in program funds advised.

ODNI / NGA — IC Postdoctoral Researcher. Drone ML, computer vision, CUDA.
